task: Eight new algebraic event candidates for 1+3 tail splitting with first-axis coupling

witness_family: all 1024 length vectors in {1,2,3,4}^5, common cube radius (product lengths)^(1/5)/2, actual unit atoms in contiguous rectangular lattice blocks
stop: After exactly 8 candidates or a registered resource cap. No winning finite model is called a C5 improvement without transfer audit.
scope: Finite-model certificates and reusable same-radius collar/smoothing argument; no claim of local or global optimality. Main team remains responsible for any C5 update.
